top_stories.title: Judge sides with Anthropic to temporarily block the Pentagon’s ban
top_stories.summary: A federal judge has sided with Anthropic, granting a temporary injunction against the Pentagon’s recent ban related to supply-chain risk, allowing Anthropic to continue providing AI services to the U.S. Department of Defense while the legal challenge proceeds. The case spotlights growing tensions between AI companies and U.S. government procurement policies.

top_stories.title: Wikipedia bans AI-generated articles
top_stories.summary: Wikipedia has instituted a ban on articles created using generative AI, citing concerns over accuracy and the spread of misinformation. This move aims to maintain the editorial integrity of the online encyclopedia and addresses growing anxieties about the reliability of AI-generated knowledge bases.

top_stories.title: Google is making it easier to import another AI’s memory into Gemini
top_stories.summary: Google’s latest update to Gemini simplifies the process of importing conversation history and context from other AI platforms, including OpenAI’s ChatGPT. This interoperability could deepen user engagement and fuel competition in the increasingly crowded AI assistant market.

top_stories.title: Webtoon is adding AI localization tools to its comics platform
top_stories.summary: Webtoon, the popular comics platform, is integrating AI-powered localization tools to streamline translation and adapt comics for global audiences. This marks another major adoption of generative AI for creative industries and raises questions around the impact on translators and copyright.

top_stories.title: Meet the Tech Reporters Using AI to Help Write and Edit Their Stories
top_stories.summary: A look inside media organizations where journalists are using AI tools to assist with reporting, drafting, and editing tasks. The shift is reshaping workflows but also reignites debates around transparency, authorship, and trust in AI-assisted content.

further_links.title: OpenAI shelves erotic chatbot ‘indefinitely’
further_links.summary: OpenAI has put plans for an adult-oriented ‘erotic mode’ chatbot on hold indefinitely following internal debate and public scrutiny over safety and content moderation challenges.

further_links.title: Apple will reportedly allow other AI chatbots to plug into Siri
further_links.summary: Apple is reportedly planning future updates that would let third-party AI chatbots integrate with Siri, opening new opportunities for AI interoperability on iOS devices.

further_links.title: Google’s ‘live’ AI search assistant can handle conversations in dozens more languages
further_links.summary: Google expands its experimental AI-powered search assistant to support natural conversations in over a dozen additional languages, aiming to reach a broader global audience.

further_links.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash Live: Making audio AI more natural and reliable
further_links.summary: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini 3.1 Flash Live, a model focused on improved reliability and naturalness in audio AI, enabling better multimodal interactions.

further_links.title: The Download: a battery pivot to AI, and rewriting math
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review details how some battery tech startups are pivoting to AI products, alongside a new tool aiming to transform how we approach mathematics with generative AI.

further_links.title: Reveal Brings Conversational AI Analytics Directly into Enterprise Applications
further_links.summary: Reveal announces new conversational AI tools designed to embed analytics functions directly into enterprise software, enhancing data-driven decision-making for businesses.

further_links.title: Chatbot Channels Introduces AI-Based Customer Communication
further_links.summary: Chatbot Channels has launched new AI-based solutions for enhancing customer communication, reflecting broader adoption of chatbots in enterprise settings.

further_links.title: GAG Token Earns a 335 Proof of Usefulness Score by Building an AI-driven Market Research and Consumer Insights Platform
further_links.summary: The GAG Token project has introduced an AI-powered platform targeting market research and consumer insight needs, blending blockchain and AI for business analytics.

further_links.title: Anaplan Announces AI-Driven Applications to Advance Enterprise Decision-Making
further_links.summary: Enterprise planning provider Anaplan launches new AI-powered applications designed to support faster and more informed decision-making in corporate environments.

further_links.title: PetaSight Acquires Babbage Insight to Strengthen AI-Powered Insight Delivery in Life Sciences Primary Market Research
further_links.summary: PetaSight has acquired Babbage Insight in a strategic move to enhance its AI-powered analytics platform for the life sciences sector, underscoring intensified AI adoption in market research.

ethan_mollick.title: The right amount of challenge for AI
ethan_mollick.summary: Ethan Mollick discusses how providing the appropriate level of challenge is crucial to making the best use of AI, drawing on research and experiments in AI-assisted learning. He explores how difficulty calibration impacts both AI effectiveness and human learning outcomes.

email_teaser: A judge sides with Anthropic in a Pentagon legal clash, Wikipedia bans AI-generated articles, and Google’s Gemini gets a big boost in compatibility. Explore how AI is reshaping publishing, translation, and newsroom productivity in today’s top stories.
